+name: CI
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+  pull_request:
+
+jobs:
+  build:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with:
+          node-version: 22
+          cache: pnpm
+      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
+      - run: pnpm check
+      - run: pnpm build
+      - run: pnpm test
+      - name: Pack audit
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          fail=0
+          for d in packages/modules/*/; do
+            (
+              cd "$d"
+              npm pack --dry-run --json > /tmp/p.json || exit 1
+              node -e '
+                const j = require("/tmp/p.json")[0];
+                const names = j.files.map(f => f.path);
+                const has = (p) => names.some(n => n === p || n.startsWith(p + "/"));
+                const pkg = require(process.cwd() + "/package.json");
+                if (!has("lynx.lib.json")) { console.error(pkg.name + ": lynx.lib.json missing"); process.exit(1); }
+                for (const twin of ["android", "ios"]) {
+                  if (require("fs").existsSync(twin) && !has(twin)) { console.error(pkg.name + ": twin " + twin + " missing"); process.exit(1); }
+                }
+              ' || exit 1
+            ) || { echo "pack audit failed: $d"; fail=1; }
+          done
+          exit $fail
+
+  native-android:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with:
+          node-version: 22
+          cache: pnpm
+      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
+        with:
+          distribution: temurin
+          java-version: '21'
+      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
+      - run: pnpm check:native:android

+name: Release
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+concurrency: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
+permissions:
+  contents: write
+  pull-requests: write
+  id-token: write
+jobs:
+  release:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 0
+      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with:
+          node-version: 22
+          cache: pnpm
+          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org
+      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
+      - run: pnpm build
+      - uses: changesets/action@v1
+        with:
+          version: pnpm changeset version
+          publish: pnpm changeset publish
+          title: 'chore: version packages'
+          commit: 'chore: version packages'
+        env:
+          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
+          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
+          NPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE: 'true'

+### Dev sandbox (no native toolchain required)
+
+1. `pnpm dev` — rspeedy prints a QR code and a bundle URL.
+2. Get LynxExplorer **pre-built** (official quick start):
+   - iOS Simulator: download `LynxExplorer-arm64.app.tar.gz` (or x86_64) from
+     the Lynx GitHub Releases, then
+     `mkdir -p LynxExplorer-arm64.app && tar -zxf LynxExplorer-arm64.app.tar.gz -C LynxExplorer-arm64.app`
+     and drag the `.app` into the Simulator.
+   - Android: install the pre-built APK from the same GitHub Release
+     (or the community Play Store build).
+   - HarmonyOS: `hdc install lynx_explorer-default-unsigned.hap`.
+3. Paste the bundle URL into Explorer ("Enter Card URL") — or scan the QR.
+   The playground's QR schema adds `?fullscreen=true&enable_napi_addon=true`,
+   which keeps working with the pre-built app (it is how the iOS launcher
+   spins up the background Node-API runtime).
+4. For in-repo host testing (registry + your modules): `pnpm host:ios` —
+   LynxpoHost is this repo's own, checkout-free host app.
+
+Version discipline: keep Explorer, pods, and Maven artifacts on the **same
+minor** (4.2.0) — bundles must match the host engine version (`engineVersion`);
+pinning one line in `Podfile` + `libs.versions.toml` + choosing the matching
+Explorer release is the whole rule.

-### Environment notes
+### Host app helpers
 
-- **Android** requires Java 11 (`JAVA_HOME=~/jdk11/Contents/Home`). `dx doctor` fails fast if the wrong JDK is active. The Gradle task is scoped to `assembleWithoutSparklingNoasanDebug` to keep the native build's disk footprint small.
-- **iOS** requires Xcode and a booted simulator (`xcrun simctl list devices booted`). `dx ios` runs `bundle_install.sh`, builds with `xcodebuild`, installs, launches, and screenshots in one step.
-- **Physical Android devices** are preferred over emulators when attached: `dx android` wires an `adb reverse tcp:8137` tunnel so the device reaches the local bundle server over USB rather than the LAN.
+- `pnpm host:bundle:copy` — copy the built `hostshowcase` bundle into LynxpoHost.
+- `pnpm host:ios` — copy the bundle and build/run LynxpoHost in the iOS Simulator.

 Key conventions (from the real package manifests):
 
 - Built with **rslib** (`rslib build`), emitting CJS + ESM + `.d.ts` under `dist/` with `publishConfig.access: public`.
-- Native twins are registered into Lynx Explorer via a `postinstall` hook that runs the **nmi** installer, so a plain `pnpm install` wires the Kotlin/Swift sources for you.
-- TS bindings for the Kotlin side are generated by the **ktts** plugin.
-- Every module declares `@lynx-js/react` and `@lynx-js/types` as dependencies; many set `"lynx": { "mainThread": "true" }` so the module runs on the UI thread.
+- Native twins are discovered through **Lynx Autolink**: host plugins scan
+  installed npm packages for `lynx.lib.json`, so no install-time copy step is
+  needed.
+- TS bindings and native specs are generated by **`@lynx-js/autolink-codegen`**
+  from `types/index.d.ts` into `src/generated/` (the official TS-first flow).
+- Every module declares `@lynx-js/react` as a peer dependency (and
+  `@lynx-js/types` for development); many set `"lynx": { "mainThread": "true" }`
+  so the module runs on the UI thread.
 
 ### A typical module's API surface
 
-The ktts generator produces a paired `getX` / `useX` accessor for each `@LynxMethod`. For async methods (`Promise` in Kotlin), the generated hook returns `{ value, loading, error }`; for sync getters it returns the raw value. This is why consumers consistently write:
+Each module exposes a paired `getX` / `useX` accessor per native method. For
+async methods (`Promise` in Kotlin), the generated hook returns
+`{ value, loading, error }`; for sync getters it returns the raw value. This is
+why consumers consistently write:
 
 ```tsx
 import { useCameraPermissionsAsync, getStartCamera } from '@lynxpo/mods-camera';
@@ -195,15 +215,15 @@ pnpm test:cov     # turbo run test:cov
 pnpm test:watch   # turbo run test:watch (persistent)
 ```

 ## Adding a module

 2. Implement the Kotlin module (`android/`) and Objective-C module (`ios/`); describe the surface in `lynx.lib.json`.

+5. Run `pnpm --filter @lynxpo/playground dev` to exercise it live; hosts pick up the twins through autolink (`lynx.lib.json`).

diff --git a/packages/modules/image-picker/android/src/main/java/com/lynxpo/imagepicker/ImagePickerProxyActivity.java b/packages/modules/image-picker/android/src/main/java/com/lynxpo/imagepicker/ImagePickerProxyActivity.java

@@ -0,0 +1,88 @@
+// Copyright 2026 The Lynxpo Authors. All rights reserved.
+// Licensed under the Apache License Version 2.0 that can be found in the
+// LICENSE file in the root directory of this source tree.
+package com.lynxpo.imagepicker;
+
+import android.app.Activity;
+import android.content.Intent;
+import android.net.Uri;
+import android.os.Bundle;
+import android.provider.MediaStore;
+import androidx.annotation.Nullable;
+import androidx.core.app.ActivityCompat;
+
+/** Hosts system pickers outside the Lynx view and forwards results to {@link ImagePickerModule}. */
+public class ImagePickerProxyActivity extends Activity {
+  private static final int REQUEST_PICK = 0x4C5A;
+  private static final int REQUEST_CAMERA = 0x4C5B;
+  private static final int REQUEST_PERMISSION = 0x4C5C;
+
+  private String pendingPermission;
+
+  @Override
+  protected void onCreate(@Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
+    super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
+    if (savedInstanceState != null) return;
+    Intent intent = getIntent();
+    String[] permissions = intent.getStringArrayExtra(ImagePickerModule.EXTRA_REQUEST_PERMISSIONS);
+    if (permissions != null && permissions.length > 0) {
+      pendingPermission = permissions[0];
+      ActivityCompat.requestPermissions(this, permissions, REQUEST_PERMISSION);
+      return;
+    }
+    int action = intent.getIntExtra(ImagePickerModule.EXTRA_PICKER_ACTION, 0);
+    if (action == ImagePickerModule.ACTION_CAMERA) {
+      String uri = intent.getStringExtra(ImagePickerModule.EXTRA_CAMERA_URI);
+      Intent capture = new Intent(MediaStore.ACTION_IMAGE_CAPTURE);
+      if (uri != null) {
+        capture.putExtra(MediaStore.EXTRA_OUTPUT, Uri.parse(uri));
+        capture.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_WRITE_URI_PERMISSION | Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION);
+      }
+      try {
+        startActivityForResult(capture, REQUEST_CAMERA);
+      } catch (Exception e) {
+        ImagePickerModule.rejectPicked(e.getMessage());
+        finish();
+      }
+    } else if (action == ImagePickerModule.ACTION_LIBRARY) {
+      Intent pick = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_PICK, MediaStore.Images.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI);
+      pick.setType("image/*");
+      try {
+        startActivityForResult(pick, REQUEST_PICK);
+      } catch (Exception e) {
+        ImagePickerModule.rejectPicked(e.getMessage());
+        finish();
+      }
+    } else {
+      finish();
+    }
+  }
+
+  @Override
+  protected void onActivityResult(int requestCode, int resultCode, @Nullable Intent data) {
+    super.onActivityResult(requestCode, resultCode, data);
+    if (requestCode == REQUEST_PERMISSION) {
+      ImagePickerModule.resolvePermission(this, pendingPermission);
+    } else if (requestCode == REQUEST_CAMERA) {
+      if (resultCode == RESULT_OK) {
+        ImagePickerModule.resolvePicked(ImagePickerModule.consumePendingCameraUri(), false);
+      } else {
+        ImagePickerModule.resolvePicked(null, true);
+      }
+    } else if (requestCode == REQUEST_PICK) {
+      Uri uri = data != null ? data.getData() : null;
+      ImagePickerModule.resolvePicked(uri, resultCode != RESULT_OK || uri == null);
+    }
+    finish();
+  }
+
+  @Override
+  public void onRequestPermissionsResult(
+      int requestCode, String[] permissions, int[] grantResults) {
+    super.onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode, permissions, grantResults);
+    if (requestCode == REQUEST_PERMISSION && pendingPermission != null) {
+      ImagePickerModule.resolvePermission(this, pendingPermission);
+    }
+    finish();
+  }
+}

+// Licensed under the Apache License Version 2.0 that can be found in the
+// LICENSE file in the root directory of this source tree.
+package com.lynxpo.linkpreview;
+
+import com.lynx.jsbridge.LynxMethod;
+import com.lynx.jsbridge.LynxNativeModule;
+import com.lynx.react.bridge.JavaOnlyArray;
+import com.lynx.react.bridge.JavaOnlyMap;
+import com.lynx.react.bridge.WritableMap;
+import com.lynx.tasm.behavior.LynxContext;
+import com.lynxpo.linkpreview.generated.LinkPreviewModuleSpec;
+
+@LynxNativeModule(name = "LinkPreviewModule")
+public class LinkPreviewModule extends LinkPreviewModuleSpec {
+
+  public LinkPreviewModule(LynxContext context) {
+    super(context);
+  }
+
+  @LynxMethod
+  public WritableMap generateLinkPreviewAsync(String url) {
+    WritableMap map = new JavaOnlyMap();
+    String safeUrl = url == null ? "" : url;
+    map.putString("url", safeUrl);
+    map.putString("title", safeUrl);
+    map.putNull("description");
+    map.putArray("images", new JavaOnlyArray());
+    return map;
+  }
+}

diff --git a/packages/modules/quick-actions/android/src/main/java/com/lynxpo/quickactions/QuickActionsModule.java b/packages/modules/quick-actions/android/src/main/java/com/lynxpo/quickactions/QuickActionsModule.java

index 0000000..95c31c4

+++ b/packages/modules/quick-actions/android/src/main/java/com/lynxpo/quickactions/QuickActionsModule.java
@@ -0,0 +1,105 @@
+// Copyright 2026 The Lynxpo Authors. All rights reserved.
+// Licensed under the Apache License Version 2.0 that can be found in the
+// LICENSE file in the root directory of this source tree.
+package com.lynxpo.quickactions;
+
+import android.content.Context;
+import android.content.SharedPreferences;
+import android.content.pm.ShortcutInfo;
+import android.content.pm.ShortcutManager;
+import android.graphics.drawable.Icon;
+import com.lynx.jsbridge.LynxMethod;
+import com.lynx.jsbridge.LynxNativeModule;
+import com.lynx.react.bridge.JavaOnlyArray;
+import com.lynx.react.bridge.JavaOnlyMap;
+import com.lynx.react.bridge.WritableArray;
+import com.lynx.react.bridge.WritableMap;
+import com.lynx.tasm.behavior.LynxContext;
+import com.lynxpo.quickactions.generated.QuickActionsModuleSpec;
+import java.util.ArrayList;
+import java.util.List;
+import org.json.JSONArray;
+import org.json.JSONObject;
+
+@LynxNativeModule(name = "QuickActionsModule")
+public class QuickActionsModule extends QuickActionsModuleSpec {
+
+  private final SharedPreferences prefs;
+
+  public QuickActionsModule(LynxContext context) {
+    super(context);
+    prefs = mContext.getSharedPreferences("lynxpo_quick_actions", Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
+  }
+
+  @LynxMethod
+  public WritableArray getShortcutItemsAsync() {
+    WritableArray out = new JavaOnlyArray();
+    ShortcutManager manager =
+        (ShortcutManager) mContext.getSystemService(Context.SHORTCUT_SERVICE);
+    if (manager == null) {
+      return out;
+    }
+    for (ShortcutInfo info : manager.getDynamicShortcuts()) {
+      WritableMap item = new JavaOnlyMap();
+      item.putString("type", info.getId());
+      item.putString("title", info.getShortLabel() == null ? "" : info.getShortLabel().toString());
+      item.putString("subtitle", info.getLongLabel() == null ? "" : info.getLongLabel().toString());
+      out.pushMap(item);
+    }
+    return out;
+  }
+
+  @LynxMethod
+  public void setShortcutItemsAsync(String items) {
+    ShortcutManager manager =
+        (ShortcutManager) mContext.getSystemService(Context.SHORTCUT_SERVICE);
+    if (manager == null) {
+      return;
+    }
+    List<ShortcutInfo> shortcuts = new ArrayList<>();
+    try {
+      JSONArray array = new JSONArray(items == null ? "[]" : items);
+      for (int i = 0; i < array.length(); i++) {
+        JSONObject item = array.getJSONObject(i);
+        String type = item.optString("type", "shortcut-" + i);
+        String title = item.optString("title", type);
+        shortcuts.add(new ShortcutInfo.Builder(mContext, type)
+            .setShortLabel(title)
+            .setLongLabel(title)
+            .setIcon(Icon.createWithResource(mContext.getPackageName(), android.R.drawable.ic_menu_compass))
+            .build());
+      }
+    } catch (Exception ignored) {
+      return;
+    }
+    manager.setDynamicShortcuts(shortcuts);
+  }
+
+  @LynxMethod
+  public void clearShortcutItemsAsync() {
+    ShortcutManager manager =
+        (ShortcutManager) mContext.getSystemService(Context.SHORTCUT_SERVICE);
+    if (manager != null) {
+      manager.removeAllDynamicShortcuts();
+    }
+    prefs.edit().remove("initialAction").apply();
+  }
+
+  @LynxMethod
+  public WritableMap initialActionAsync() {
+    String raw = prefs.getString("initialAction", null);
+    if (raw == null) {
+      return null;
+    }
+    try {
+      JSONObject json = new JSONObject(raw);
+      WritableMap out = new JavaOnlyMap();
+      out.putString("type", json.optString("type", ""));
+      out.putString("title", json.optString("title", ""));
+      out.putString("subtitle", json.optString("subtitle", ""));
+      return out;
+    } catch (Exception ignored) {
+      return null;
+    }
+  }
+}

diff --git a/packages/modules/receive-sharing/android/src/main/java/com/lynxpo/receivesharing/ReceiveSharingModule.java b/packages/modules/receive-sharing/android/src/main/java/com/lynxpo/receivesharing/ReceiveSharingModule.java
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..8ae824e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/modules/receive-sharing/android/src/main/java/com/lynxpo/receivesharing/ReceiveSharingModule.java
@@ -0,0 +1,63 @@
+// Copyright 2026 The Lynxpo Authors. All rights reserved.
+// Licensed under the Apache License Version 2.0 that can be found in the
+// LICENSE file in the root directory of this source tree.
+package com.lynxpo.receivesharing;
+
+import android.content.Context;
+import android.content.SharedPreferences;
+import com.lynx.jsbridge.LynxMethod;
+import com.lynx.jsbridge.LynxNativeModule;
+import com.lynx.react.bridge.JavaOnlyArray;
+import com.lynx.react.bridge.JavaOnlyMap;
+import com.lynx.react.bridge.WritableMap;
+import com.lynx.tasm.behavior.LynxContext;
+import com.lynxpo.receivesharing.generated.ReceiveSharingModuleSpec;
+import org.json.JSONArray;
+import org.json.JSONObject;
+
+@LynxNativeModule(name = "ReceiveSharingModule")
+public class ReceiveSharingModule extends ReceiveSharingModuleSpec {
+
+  private final SharedPreferences prefs;
+
+  public ReceiveSharingModule(LynxContext context) {
+    super(context);
+    prefs = mContext.getSharedPreferences("lynxpo_receive_sharing", Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
+  }
+
+  @LynxMethod
+  public WritableMap getInitialIntentAsync() {
+    String raw = prefs.getString("intent", null);
+    if (raw == null) {
+      return null;
+    }
+    try {
+      JSONObject json = new JSONObject(raw);
+      WritableMap out = new JavaOnlyMap();
+      out.putString("action", json.optString("action", ""));
+      out.putString("type", json.optString("type", ""));
+      out.putString("text", json.optString("text", ""));
+      out.putString("url", json.optString("url", ""));
+      JSONArray files = json.optJSONArray("files");
+      JavaOnlyArray array = new JavaOnlyArray();
+      if (files != null) {
+        for (int i = 0; i < files.length(); i++) {
+          array.pushString(files.optString(i, ""));
+        }
+      }
+      out.putArray("files", array);
+      return out;
+    } catch (Exception ignored) {
+      return null;
+    }
+  }
+
+  @LynxMethod
+  public boolean hasIntentAsync() {
+    return prefs.contains("intent");
+  }
+
+  @LynxMethod
+  public void addListener(String event) {
+  }
+}

+// Copyright 2026 The Lynxpo Authors. All rights reserved.
+// Licensed under the Apache License Version 2.0 that can be found in the
+// LICENSE file in the root directory of this source tree.
+package com.lynxpo.updates;
+
+import com.lynx.jsbridge.LynxMethod;
+import com.lynx.jsbridge.LynxNativeModule;
+import com.lynx.react.bridge.JavaOnlyMap;
+import com.lynx.react.bridge.WritableMap;
+import com.lynx.tasm.behavior.LynxContext;
+import com.lynxpo.updates.generated.UpdatesModuleSpec;
+
+@LynxNativeModule(name = "UpdatesModule")
+public class UpdatesModule extends UpdatesModuleSpec {
+
+  public UpdatesModule(LynxContext context) {
+    super(context);
+  }
+
+  @LynxMethod
+  public WritableMap getNativeStateAsync() {
+    WritableMap map = new JavaOnlyMap();
+    map.putBoolean("isUpdateAvailable", false);
+    map.putBoolean("isEmergencyUpdate", false);
+    map.putBoolean("isRollback", false);
+    map.putBoolean("checkAutomatically", true);
+    map.putString("updateId", "");
+    map.putDouble("createdAt", 0);
+    return map;
+  }
+
+  @LynxMethod
+  public WritableMap checkForUpdateAsync() {
+    WritableMap map = new JavaOnlyMap();
+    map.putBoolean("isAvailable", false);
+    map.putString("reason", "no-remote-config");
+    return map;
+  }
+
+  @LynxMethod
+  public WritableMap fetchUpdateAsync() {
+    WritableMap map = new JavaOnlyMap();
+    map.putBoolean("isNew", false);
+    map.putNull("manifest");
+    map.putNull("error");
+    return map;
+  }
+
+  @LynxMethod
+  public boolean isUpdateAvailableAsync() {
+    return false;
+  }
+
+  @LynxMethod
+  public void reloadAsync() {
+  }
+}

-# 💡 About the project
-
-Native module installer for [Lynx](https://lynxjs.org)
-
-## ✨ Features
-
-- Install native modules into [Lynx Explorer](https://lynxjs.org/guide/start/quick-start.html)
-- Automatic Module Discovery: The script now automatically discovers all module files in the source directories instead of hardcoding specific module names.
-- Configurable Paths: All paths are now configurable through a central configuration object, making it easy to adapt to different project structures.
-- Unified Interface: A single function handles both Android and iOS module installation with platform-specific logic abstracted away.
-
-## 🎉 Getting started
-
-### How to Use the Script
-
-To install all native modules:
-
-```bash
-pnpx @lynxpo/tools-nmi /path/to/explorer
-```
-
-To use programmatically with custom configuration:
-
-```ts
-import { installNativeModules } from './native-module-installer';
-installNativeModules({
-  explorerDir: '/path/to/explorer',
-  moduleSources: ['src/custom-android', 'src/custom-ios'],
-  androidConfig: {
-    modulesPath: 'custom/android/path'
-  }
-});
-```
-
-The script will:
-
-- Discover all modules in the source directories
-- Copy them to the appropriate target directories
-- Register them in the respective adapter files
-- Provide instructions for manual steps if needed (e.g., adding files to Xcode)
-

+#!/usr/bin/env node
+/** Strip the nmi postinstall hook and devDependency from every module. */
+import { existsSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { join } from 'node:path';
+
+const modulesDir = join(process.cwd(), 'packages/modules');
+let touched = 0;
+
+for (const name of readdirSync(modulesDir)) {
+  const pkgPath = join(modulesDir, name, 'package.json');
+  if (!existsSync(pkgPath)) continue;
+  const pkg = JSON.parse(readFileSync(pkgPath, 'utf8'));
+
+  delete pkg.scripts?.postinstall;
+  if (pkg.devDependencies) delete pkg.devDependencies['@lynxpo/tools-nmi'];
+
+  writeFileSync(pkgPath, JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2) + '\n');
+  touched++;
+}
+console.log(`stripped nmi hooks from ${touched} packages`);

+#!/usr/bin/env node
+/** Remove the ktts plugin from every module rslib.config.ts. */
+import { existsSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { join } from 'node:path';
+
+const modulesDir = join(process.cwd(), 'packages/modules');
+let changed = 0;
+
+for (const name of readdirSync(modulesDir)) {
+  const cfgPath = join(modulesDir, name, 'rslib.config.ts');
+  if (!existsSync(cfgPath)) continue;
+  let src = readFileSync(cfgPath, 'utf8');
+  const before = src;
+
+  // Drop the import …
+  src = src.replace(/import \{ pluginKotlinToTS \} from '@lynxpo\/plugins-ktts';\n/, '');
+  // … and the whole plugins: [ pluginKotlinToTS({ … }) ] block (balanced braces).
+  const start = src.indexOf('  plugins: [');
+  if (start !== -1) {
+    let depth = 0;
+    let i = src.indexOf('[', start);
+    for (; i < src.length; i++) {
+      if (src[i] === '[') depth++;
+      else if (src[i] === ']') {
+        depth--;
+        if (depth === 0) {
+          i++;
+          break;
+        }
+      }
+    }
+    src = src.slice(0, start) + src.slice(i).replace(/^\s*,?\n/, '\n');
+  }
+
+  if (src !== before) {
+    writeFileSync(cfgPath, src);
+    changed++;
+  }
+}
+console.log(`rewrote ${changed} rslib configs (ktts removed)`);
diff --git a/scripts/migrate/03-rebase-facades.mjs b/scripts/migrate/03-rebase-facades.mjs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..474de89
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/migrate/03-rebase-facades.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env node
+/**
+ * Rebase ktts-shaped facades (9 modules) onto the official
+ * @lynx-js/autolink-codegen output in src/generated/.
+ * Before: import type {NativeModules as INativeModules} …;
+ *         export interface X extends INativeModules {…};  NativeModules.X?.m?.()
+ * After:  import { X } from './generated/X';              X?.m?.()
+ * The interface block is removed — it would duplicate-identifier-collide with
+ * the imported binding, and the binding already declares the full shape.
+ */
+import { existsSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { join } from 'node:path';
+
+const modulesDir = join(process.cwd(), 'packages/modules');
+const rebased = [];
+
+for (const name of readdirSync(modulesDir)) {
+  const indexPath = join(modulesDir, name, 'src/index.ts');
+  if (!existsSync(indexPath)) continue;
+  let src = readFileSync(indexPath, 'utf8');
+  if (!/extends INativeModules/.test(src) || src.includes("from './generated/")) continue;
+
+  // Module binding name as declared by the generated file (e.g. Appearance).
+  const genDir = join(modulesDir, name, 'src/generated');
+  const genFile = readdirSync(genDir).find((f) => f.endsWith('.ts'));
+  if (!genFile) throw new Error(`${name}: no generated binding to rebase onto`);
+  const binding = genFile.replace(/\.ts$/, '');
+  const exportLine = readFileSync(join(genDir, genFile), 'utf8').match(/export const (\w+):/)?.[1];
+  if (exportLine !== binding) throw new Error(`${name}: unexpected export ${exportLine}`);
+
+  // 1. drop the INativeModules type import and the interface block
+  src = src.replace(/^import type \{ NativeModules as INativeModules \} from '@lynx-js\/types';\n/m, '');
+  src = src.replace(
+    new RegExp(`export interface ${binding} extends INativeModules \\{[\\s\\S]*?\\n\\}\\n`),
+    '',
+  );
+  // 2. import right after the last remaining import
+  const imports = [...src.matchAll(/^import .*$/gm)];
+  const lastImport = imports.at(-1)?.[0];
+  src = src.replace(lastImport, `${lastImport}\nimport { ${binding} } from './generated/${binding}';`);
+  // 3. accessor swap
+  src = src.replaceAll(`NativeModules.${binding}?.`, `${binding}?.`);
+  if (src.includes('INativeModules')) throw new Error(`${name}: stale INativeModules reference`);
+
+  writeFileSync(indexPath, src);
+  rebased.push(name);
+}
+console.log(`rebased facades: ${rebased.join(', ') || '(none)'}`);

+#!/usr/bin/env node
+/**
+ * Normalize every @lynxpo/mods-* package for npm publishing:
+ *  - strip nmi/ktts workspace devDeps + hooks (idempotent)
+ *  - peer-out @lynx-js/react, dev-only @lynx-js/types
+ *  - ship lynx.lib.json + native twins in files (official autolink layout)
+ *  - add license/repository/keywords/sideEffects, bump 0.0.0 -> 0.1.0
+ */
+import { existsSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, writeFileSync, copyFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { join } from 'node:path';
+
+const REPO_URL = 'git+https://github.com/elcoosp/lynxpo.git';
+const modulesDir = join(process.cwd(), 'packages/modules');
+const rootLicense = join(process.cwd(), 'LICENSE');
+const report = [];
+
+for (const name of readdirSync(modulesDir)) {
+  const dir = join(modulesDir, name);
+  const pkgPath = join(dir, 'package.json');
+  if (!existsSync(pkgPath)) continue;
+  const pkg = JSON.parse(readFileSync(pkgPath, 'utf8'));
+  if (!pkg.name?.startsWith('@lynxpo/mods-')) continue;
+
+  // --- idempotent relic strip (safe even if 01/02 were skipped)
+  delete pkg.scripts?.postinstall;
+  if (pkg.devDependencies) {
+    delete pkg.devDependencies['@lynxpo/tools-nmi'];
+    delete pkg.devDependencies['@lynxpo/plugins-ktts'];
+  }
+
+  // --- runtime deps -> peer + dev (all 66 have exactly the two lynx deps)
+  const hadReact = Boolean(pkg.dependencies?.['@lynx-js/react']);
+  delete pkg.dependencies;
+  pkg.peerDependencies = hadReact ? { '@lynx-js/react': '>=0.126.0 <1' } : undefined;
+  if (!pkg.peerDependencies) delete pkg.peerDependencies;
+  pkg.devDependencies = {
+    ...(pkg.devDependencies ?? {}),
+    ...(hadReact ? { '@lynx-js/react': '^0.126.0' } : {}),
+    '@lynx-js/types': '^4.0.0',
+  };
+
+  // --- files: official autolink layout (manifest + twins + types + dist)
+  const files = new Set(['dist', 'lynx.lib.json', 'types']);
+  for (const twin of ['android', 'ios']) {
+    if (existsSync(join(dir, twin))) files.add(twin);
+  }
+  pkg.files = [...files].sort();
+
+  // --- metadata
+  if (pkg.version === '0.0.0') pkg.version = '0.1.0';
+  pkg.license = 'Apache-2.0';
+  pkg.sideEffects = false;
+  pkg.repository = { type: 'git', url: REPO_URL, directory: `packages/modules/${name}` };
+  pkg.bugs = { url: 'https://github.com/elcoosp/lynxpo/issues' };
+  pkg.homepage = `https://github.com/elcoosp/lynxpo/tree/main/packages/modules/${name}#readme`;
+  pkg.keywords = [...new Set(['lynx', 'lynxjs', 'react-lynx', 'autolink', 'expo', name])].sort();
+  pkg.exports = {
+    '.': {
+      types: './dist/index.d.ts',
+      import: './dist/index.js',
+      require: './dist/cjs/index.cjs',
+    },
+  };
+
+  // LICENSE must sit inside the package dir to land in the tarball
+  if (existsSync(rootLicense)) copyFileSync(rootLicense, join(dir, 'LICENSE'));
+
+  writeFileSync(pkgPath, JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2) + '\n');
+  report.push(`${pkg.name}@${pkg.version}  files=[${pkg.files.join(',')}]`);
+}
+console.log(report.join('\n'));
